skill-revision-compare.title: Compare revisions
skill-revision-compare.intro: Compare the original approved text of two fixed catalog versions.
skill-revision-compare.not_enough: Only one version is available. A second fixed version is needed to compare.
skill-revision-compare.editor_failed: The local comparison editor could not load. Retry it or use plain text comparison.
skill-revision-compare.retry_read: Read current skill and history again
skill-revision-compare.boundary: History is read-only. Adopting the effective current version creates a project draft for the existing review process; it never upgrades existing tasks or runs.
skill-revision-compare.invalid_read: The revision history does not match this fixed skill. Read it again.
